Container.Name: Obsidian Livesync Bridge
Container.Overview:
Obsidian Self-hosted LiveSync Bridge: replicates a local Obsidian vault folder bidirectionally with CouchDB (LiveSync protocol). Runs headless (Deno, no GUI) - perfect for bringing agent-written markdown files (e.g. Hermes daily notes) into the LiveSync loop.
The vault folder is mounted to /app/vault (storage peer), CouchDB is configured as a couchdb peer. Config lives in /app/dat/config.json (see config.sample.json after first start).
After first start: copy /mnt/user/appdata/livesync-bridge/config/config.sample.json to config.json, configure the peers, restart the container.

Config.Name: Path: Obsidian Vault
Config.Description: The Obsidian vault folder (storage peer, baseDir ./vault/)

Config.Name: Variable: LSB_FULL_SYNC
Config.Description: Set to true to force a full sync on next start (resets automatically)
